contradictions.topic: CADR sizing rule: Digit two-thirds of area vs Smartprix 400 m3/h for 250 sq ft
contradictions.assessment: Digit's rule implies about 233 m3/h for 350 sq ft; Smartprix is much stricter. Digit rated more reliable by the tool (59 vs 55) but neither is tested; Smartprix reasoning (3-4 air changes/hour) suits Delhi's heavy pollution.
